component.name: Fdebi
component.summary: Install local .deb packages with dependency resolving
component.name: Fdebi
component.summary: 可视化安装本地 .deb 软件包并解析依赖

description.p: fdebi installs local .deb packages with a GTK4 interface: it shows package metadata and file lists, checks dependencies against the system apt cache, previews conffile changes and installs via dpkg with live progress.
Dependency solving, downloading and the privileged installation run in the org.fdebi system daemon (authorized via polkit), so the frontend itself never runs with elevated privileges.
fdebi 以 GTK4 界面安装本地 .deb 软件包:展示包元数据与文件列表,依据系统 apt 缓存检查依赖,预览配置文件变更,并通过 dpkg 安装、实时呈现进度。
依赖求解、下载与特权安装均在 org.fdebi 系统守护进程内完成(经 polkit 授权),前端自身不以特权运行。
依赖求解切换到系统 libapt-pkg(C++ FFI),与系统包管理器行为一致;新增批量安装与 conffile 冲突预检。
